DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市民講座へ参加したいです。妻の名前で用紙を書きましたが、私も申し込む欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻名義の講座用紙に本人の参加も申し込む方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to attend a community course. I filled in the form in my wife's name. Is there a section where I can apply for myself too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to apply for your own participation on a course form filled in under your wife's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加を希望する方を別々に確認します。奥様も参加を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check each prospective participant separately. Does your wife want to attend too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ妻に聞いていません。二人で行きたいと思って、先に書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻へ未確認で二人参加を先に想定して記入したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked her yet. I filled it in first because I thought we could go together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you filled in the form assuming you would both attend before checking with your wife. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未確認の参加を決めず、まずご本人の希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than deciding on participation that has not been confirmed, let us first ask about your own wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は参加したいです。妻の分は本人に聞いてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人参加を希望し妻分は本人確認後に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to attend. I will ask my wife herself before discussing her application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to attend yourself and will discuss your wife's participation after checking with her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ではお客様ご自身の申込方法を案内します。人数や空き状況は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will explain how you can apply in your own name. The person in charge will check the number of participants and availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人分の席が取れたと妻に言わず、私の申込結果だけを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人分確保とは伝えず自分の申込結果だけ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not tell my wife that places have been secured for two people. I will tell her only the result of my own application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will report only the result of your own application, without saying two places have been secured. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。希望の登録と参加確定も分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also distinguish between registering your interest and having participation confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の名前へ用紙を直し、妻への確認と参加結果の連絡は別に行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名へ訂正し妻意向確認と参加確定確認を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will change the form to my own name, and handle checking my wife's wishes and communicating the participation result separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct the form to your own name and distinguish checking your wife's wishes from confirming participation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。講座の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take you to the person in charge of the course.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 支払いについて、私から答えたいです。連れは現金と言いましたが、まだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者が現金と答えたが本人が未決定なので自分から相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to answer about payment myself. My companion said cash, but I have not decided yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that although your companion answered cash, you have not decided and would like to discuss it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお支払い前ですね。ご本人の希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not paid yet, correct? Let me hear your own preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードを使えるか知りたいです。連れの財布で払う予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分のカード可否を尋ね同行者の財布で払う予定でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to know whether I can use a card. I do not plan to pay from my companion's wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use your own card and explain that you do not plan to pay using your companion's wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用会計の対応表示を確認しましょう。お使いになりたいカードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the accepted payment signs for this practice checkout. Do you have the card you would like to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分のカードを持っています。使えるか確認できてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人カードを持参し利用可否後に支払方法を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my own card. I will choose after confirming whether it can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have brought your own card and will choose a payment method after checking whether it is accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認中に現金の支払いを進めずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will wait without proceeding with a cash payment while checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。連れには、私が方法を決めるまで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ本人決定まで待つよう頼むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will ask my companion to wait until I decide on a method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your companion to wait until you make your own decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。利用できる方法の説明後、改めてご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After explaining the available methods, we will ask for your preference again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて自分の方法を選び、金額も確認してから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後本人が方法と金額を確認して支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen to the explanation, choose my own method, and check the amount before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after hearing the explanation, you will choose the method yourself, confirm the amount, and pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず対応するカードを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let us check which cards are accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りた鞄から財布が出てきました。道で拾った物ではないので、扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用鞄内で見つけた財布の扱いを路上拾得と区別して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a wallet inside a bag I borrowed. I did not find it on the street, so I would like to ask how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle a wallet found in a borrowed bag, distinguishing it from an item found on the street. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鞄を借りた相手に、財布について確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked with the person you borrowed the bag from about the wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人は自分の財布ではないと言いました。その前に誰が鞄を使ったかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は非所有と答え以前の鞄利用者は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend said it was not their wallet. I do not know who used the bag before that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend said they do not own it and that the bag's earlier user is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけた状況を伺います。いつ財布に気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me ask how you found it. When did you notice the wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝、内側の小さいポケットを開けたときです。財布の中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝内ポケットで発見し財布未開封と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning, when I opened a small pocket inside. I have not looked inside the wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you found it in an inside pocket this morning and have not opened the wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままの状態で確認しましょう。鞄の所有者と財布の所有者を同じと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check it as it is. We will not assume the bag and the wallet have the same owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 財布だけを自分で持ってきました。借りた鞄は友人に返してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布のみ持参し鞄は友人へ返却済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought only the wallet myself. I have already returned the borrowed bag to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have brought only the wallet and have already returned the bag to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。必要な経緯を担当へ伝え、今後の確認方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will pass the necessary background to the person in charge and explain how to make further checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の物と断定せず、借りた鞄のポケットで見つけたと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人所有を断定せず借用鞄での発見経緯を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I found it in the pocket of a borrowed bag, without stating that it belongs to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the person in charge how you found it in a borrowed bag, without asserting that your friend owns it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 借りた鞄で見つけた経緯として担当へ伝えます。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you found it in a borrowed bag. Thank you for asking us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 再配達を頼みたいです。午後なら家族がいると思いましたが、外出するとわかりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達予定の家族が午後外出と判明したため別時間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to request redelivery. I thought my family would be home in the afternoon, but I found out they will be out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about another time for redelivery after learning that the family member you expected to receive it will be out in the afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ再配達の申込みはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not requested redelivery yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家族の予定を聞いてから申し込むつもりで、まだ操作していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族予定の確認後に申込むつもりでまだ未操作と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I planned to apply after asking about my family's schedule, so I have not entered anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you planned to request redelivery after checking your family's schedule and have not performed any operation yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では実際に受け取れる方の予定で考えましょう。ご本人はいつ在宅されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us work around the schedule of someone who can actually receive it. When will you be home yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午前なら私がいます。その時間帯が選べるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が明日午前在宅なので利用可能な時間帯を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will be there tomorrow morning. I would like to know whether I can select that time slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will be home tomorrow morning and ask which available time slots you can use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この票の申込方法で、選べる日時を確認できます。必ず希望時刻になるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the available dates and times using the application method on this notice. You may not necessarily get the exact time you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 選択肢を見て、私が在宅する時間に合うものだけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示候補のうち本人在宅に合う選択肢だけ選ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the options and select only one that matches when I am home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will select only an available option that matches your own time at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。申込後も、受付された日時を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After applying, please also check the date and time that have been accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族任せにせず、自分の在宅予定と受付日時を照合して申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族任せにせず本人予定と受付日時を照合して申込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not leave it to my family. I will apply while checking my own schedule against the accepted date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will make the request by checking your own schedule against the accepted date and time, rather than leaving it to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不明な選択肢があればお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask if you are unsure about any option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使っていない口座の扱いを相談したいです。給与の口座は使い続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用口座の相談を希望し給与口座は継続すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like advice about an account I do not use. I will continue using my salary account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to discuss an unused account and will keep your salary account in use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの口座を分けて確認します。対象のカードはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the two accounts separately. Do you know which card is for the account concerned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードは二枚ありますが、色だけではどちらかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード二枚の対象を色では識別できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have two cards, but I cannot tell which is which just by their colors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot identify the relevant one of two cards by color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座情報を担当と照合しましょう。色や見た目だけで対象を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us match the account details with the person in charge. Please do not decide which account it is by color or appearance alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 給与が入る口座の情報を持っています。そちらを残す希望だと先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 給与口座資料を示しその口座を残す希望を先に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the details of the account my salary goes into. I will first explain that I want to keep that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the details of your salary account and first say that you want to keep that account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。もう一方について、現在の利用と残る取引を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will check how the other account is currently used and what transactions remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐ全部止めたいわけではありません。使わない口座の条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全口座の即停止でなく未使用口座の条件確認が目的と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to stop everything immediately. I would like to ask about the conditions for the account I do not use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that your purpose is to check the conditions for the unused account, rather than immediately stop every account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。照合と説明後、実際に行う手続きをご本人が選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After the details are matched and explained, you will choose which procedure to carry out yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 給与口座を残すことを確認し、もう一方だけの扱いを説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 給与口座継続を照合し他方のみ扱い説明を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm that my salary account is to remain in use and have the handling of only the other account explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm continued use of the salary account and receive an explanation concerning only the other one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take you to the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この果物の袋に、つぶれている物があります。まだ買っていませんが、見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未購入果物袋に潰れた物を発見したため確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Some of the fruit in this bag is crushed. I have not bought it yet. Could you take a look?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a check after finding crushed fruit in a bag you have not bought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売場で気づかれたのですね。ご自身で袋を開けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You noticed it on the sales floor, correct? Did you open the bag yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。外から汁が付いているのが見えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封で外から汁が見えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened it. I could see juice on it from the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag is unopened and you could see juice from outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋をここへ置いてください。売場の担当が状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please place the bag here. The staff member for that section will check its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買った物の交換ではなく、棚の商品に気づいたということです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入後交換でなく陳列商品の状態報告だと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am reporting something I noticed on the shelf, rather than asking to exchange a purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are reporting the condition of an item on display, rather than requesting a post-purchase exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、未購入の商品の報告として伺いました。別の商品をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I have taken this as a report about an item you have not bought. Are you looking for another item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日食べる分を別に選びたいです。この袋は棚に戻さずお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日用の別商品を選び対象袋は棚へ戻さず渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to choose something else to eat today. I will hand this bag to you rather than put it back on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will select another item for today and hand over this bag instead of returning it to the shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりします。別の袋も外から状態を確認して選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take it here. You can check other bags from the outside too before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この袋を担当へ渡し、問題が見えない別の商品を選んでから会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 報告品を渡し他商品状態を見てから会計すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give this bag to the person in charge, select another item without any visible problem, and then pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over the item you reported, check the condition of another item, and then pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせくださりありがとうございます。どうぞお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please go ahead and choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 下の道へ行きたいです。この雪の坂を歩いて横切れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雪の坂を歩いて横切り下の道へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to get to the path below. Can I walk across this snowy slope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can walk across the snowy slope to reach the lower path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この区域はそり遊びの斜面です。一般の通行は別の道をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This area is a sledding slope. Please use a different path for normal passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い道だと思いました。子どもが上から滑ってくる場所なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近道と思ったがそりで子供が滑走する区域だと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a shortcut. So this is where children slide down from above.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought it was a shortcut but now understand it is an area where children sled down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。途中へ出ず、周囲の歩行者用表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Rather than stepping out onto the slope, let us check the pedestrian signs around it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そりは持っていません。遊ぶのでなく出口へ戻る道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: そり遊びでなく出口へ戻る歩行道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have a sled. I am not here to play; I would like to know the way back to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want a pedestrian route back to the exit, rather than to go sledding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩行者用の道はこの矢印です。斜面の外側を回って出口へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This arrow marks the pedestrian path. You can go around the outside of the slope and return to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し遠くてもそちらを歩きます。子どもの滑る先を横切りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遠回りの歩行道を選び滑走先を横切らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take that path even if it is a little farther. I will not cross in front of the children sliding down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose the longer pedestrian route and not cross the sledding run. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。足元の状態を見て、無理せず進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Watch the ground and take your time as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 遊びの区域へ入らず、歩行者用の表示に沿って出口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遊戯区域へ入らず歩行者表示に沿って出口へ戻ると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stay out of the play area and follow the pedestrian signs back to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will stay out of the play area and follow the pedestrian signs back to the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連れがまだ来ません。改札を通らず、ここで呼んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者未到着で改札を通らず入口から呼んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion has not arrived yet. May I call to them from here without going through the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may call your companion from the entrance without passing through the gates because they have not arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札の入口は空けてください。こちらの待機場所から連絡できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep the entrance to the ticket gates clear. You can contact them from this waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで立っていたので、後ろの人が通れませんでした。脇へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口を塞いでいたと気づき脇へ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was standing here and blocking the people behind me. I will move to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you realized you were blocking the entrance and will move to the side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まだ切符は使っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. You have not used your ticket yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私だけ先に入らず、改札の外で連れと合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符未使用で本人だけ入らず改札外合流を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I would like to meet my companion outside the gates rather than go in ahead of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your ticket is unused and you want to meet outside the gates rather than enter on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、待つ場所の目印を相手へ伝えるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then it would be good to tell them a landmark where you will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待機場所の青い案内板の横にいると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機場所の青い案内板横を同行者へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell them I am beside the blue information board in the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your companion you are beside the blue information board in the waiting area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここでは、その案内板がこちらです。入口とは別の場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here, that information board is over this way. It is separate from the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い案内板の横で合流し、二人そろってから改札へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定板横で合流後二人で改札へ向かうと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will meet beside the blue information board and go to the ticket gates once we are both together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will meet beside the specified board and then go to the ticket gates together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通行に気をつけてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch out for people passing while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 届いた通知が破れて、一部が読めません。残った紙で照会できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 破損通知の残存部分で照会できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice I received is torn, and I cannot read part of it. Can I make an inquiry using the paper that remains?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can make an inquiry using the remaining part of a damaged notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読める表題と発行元をまず確認します。破片もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the readable title and issuer. Have you brought the torn pieces too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、封筒と破片を持ってきました。数字の後ろが欠けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒と破片を提示し数字末尾が欠けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I brought the envelope and the pieces. The end of the number is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and torn pieces and explain that the end of the number is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 欠けた数字を推測して記入や支払いをしないでください。照会できる担当を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not fill anything in or make a payment by guessing the missing digits. I will check which staff member can help with the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読める部分から金額を決めず、元の内容を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部分数字で金額を推測せず原内容の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to confirm the original contents rather than determine the amount from the part I can read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to confirm the original contents without guessing the amount from partial digits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 照会番号が読める場合は役立ちます。ここにある文字を担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the reference number is readable, it will help. Let us check the characters here with the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は読めます。破れた紙を捨てず、封筒と一緒に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読める照会番号と破片封筒を保持して担当へ見せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read the reference number. I will keep the torn paper and show it with the envelope rather than throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the readable reference number, pieces, and envelope and show them to the staff member in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が原内容の確認方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will explain how to check the original contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表題と番号で相談し、期限や金額は確認できるまで決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表題と番号で照会し期限金額を確認前に断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will inquire using the title and reference number, and will not assume the deadline or amount until they are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will inquire using the title and number and not state the deadline or amount as certain before checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当窓口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. The counter in charge is over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: オンラインで問診を送りました。送信済みと出たので、今日の診察も予約できているでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診送信済み表示で本日診察予約もできたか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I submitted the medical questionnaire online. It says sent, so does that mean I also have an appointment for today's consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the questionnaire's sent status also means you have booked today's consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 問診の送信と診察の予約は別に確認します。受診日時を選びましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Submitting the questionnaire and booking an appointment need to be checked separately. Did you choose a consultation date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 選んでいません。症状を入力した後に完了したので、予約も含まれると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時未選択で症状入力完了を予約込みと誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not. It said complete after I entered my symptoms, so I thought that included the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not select a date or time and mistook completion of symptom entry for including an appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日時を指定した予約ではないということですね。受付担当へ問診の記録と受診希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you have not made a booking for a specified date and time. I will tell reception about the questionnaire record and your wish to be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ問診をもう一つ作らず、送った情報を確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 問診を重複作成せず送信済み情報の照会を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like you to check the information I sent rather than create another copy of the same questionnaire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the submitted information to be checked without creating a duplicate questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前と送信した時刻を伺います。今日の受診については担当が受付方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: May I have your name and the time you sent it? The staff member in charge will explain how to register for a consultation today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝八時に送りました。今日は初めての受診で、すでに予約があるとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今朝八時送信で初診かつ予約済みと主張しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sent it at eight this morning. This is my first consultation here, and I will not say that I already have an appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you submitted it at eight this morning, are a first-time patient, and will not claim to have an existing appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認中は今の完了画面を残してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please keep the current completion screen and wait while we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問診送信済みで日時の予約は未確認と説明し、担当から受診の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送信と日時予約を区別し担当の受診受付案内を聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that the questionnaire has been sent but the appointment date and time are unconfirmed, and listen to the staff member's instructions for being seen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish questionnaire submission from a dated appointment and say that you will listen to the staff member's registration guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容でおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I will pass that on. Thank you for asking us.
